detector.description: Alerts when k8s node cpu utilization is more than 95% for last 5 min.
detector.name: K8s node cpu > 95% for 5 min
detector.programText:
A = data('cpu.utilization', filter=filter('k8s.cluster.name', '*')).mean(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'k8s.node.name']).publish(label='A')
detect(when(A > threshold(95), lasting='5m', at_least=1), auto_resolve_after='15d').publish('K8s node cpu > 95% for 5 min')

rules.description: The value of CPU (%) is above 95 for 5m.
